scenario_text: A payment platform attributes outages entirely to external vendors despite evidence of internal capacity issues.
A payment platform reviews both vendor performance and internal capacity issues.
A clinic claims patient safety is improving despite rising adverse-event rates.
A clinic investigates rising adverse-event rates and updates procedures.
A logistics network blames weather for delays despite known routing inefficiencies.
A logistics network evaluates both weather impact and routing inefficiencies.
A software organization claims release quality is improving despite rising defect rates.
A software organization investigates the causes of rising defect rates.
A team insists morale is strong despite survey results showing widespread dissatisfaction.
A team incorporates survey results into its assessment of morale.
